profile.title: Full Stack & Web Developer

profile.detailedBio: I am a passionate web developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering robust, scalable web applications and high-performance APIs. I focus on clean code, intuitive developer experiences, and resilient system architectures. My primary stack spans React, TypeScript, Python, Django, Node.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.

profile.currentFocus: Building real-time distributed platforms & AI-integrated SaaS applications

projects.longDescription:
AR EDITZ is a creative editing studio dedicated to turning ideas into high-quality visual content. From engaging video edits to eye-catching poster designs, every project is crafted with attention to detail, creativity, and a professional finish.

Explore our work, view our latest samples, and find the style that fits your vision. When you're ready, send your preferred sample directly to the editor and let's bring your idea to life.

experiences.description: Leading the development of core web applications, cloud orchestrations, and API microservices. Mentoring developers and architecting high-throughput data pipelines.

Migrated legacy monolithic systems to modular TypeScript & Django REST services.

Implemented real-time collaboration features using WebSockets and Supabase.
Designed comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
